servers.name: personal
servers.guidance: Indexed mail and Drive first: Preloaded context and mindos_mail_lookup for Gmail bodies/attachments; mindos_search for mixed sources. Before filesystem tools when the user names attachments, people, or threads. Do not mindos_gmail_sync or mindos_process_outbox when Preloaded context or lookup/search already has [gmail] hits, or when sync returns ingested=0. mindos_calendar_* for schedule; mindos_summarize_url for URL/PDF content; only if Preloaded+lookup/search lack mail: mindos_gmail_sync(query=<Gmail q>, max_messages≈25) then mindos_process_outbox only if ingested>0, then mindos_mail_lookup—not blank mindos_gmail_sync unless user wants full inbox refresh.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.guidance: Local disk only—not Gmail/Drive ingested mail. Use mindos_mail_lookup or mindos_search first for mail/Drive. Default search is MINDOS_HOME (project), not whole ~. For personal files: mindos_fs_list("~") then glob/grep with root=~/Downloads|Desktop|Documents; deep=True only if they want a wide scan. Configure agents.filesystem.search_paths for your usual folders. Destructive: preview then confirmed=True.

servers.name: convert
servers.guidance: Local conversion; source unchanged. mindos_fs_locate or mindos_convert_file (paths from user words). Batch: mindos_convert_batch previews then confirmed=True.

servers.name: fetch
servers.guidance: Backend for mindos_summarize_url (PDF/HTML pagination). Do not call fetch_* directly for user summarize requests—use mindos_summarize_url instead. search_web only for open-web queries without a URL.
